release_scope.proofs_and_source_snapshots: trusted research archive frozen before first new Coverage

preregistration_rationale.diagnostic_evidence: All completed checkpoints analyzed together; centered readout feature variation largely rank one; high-dimensional perturbations destabilize graph encoding and structural direction.
preregistration_rationale.change: Freeze a completely data-independent positive encoder with uniform attention; train only the 33 readout coordinates with public post-noise box projection.
preregistration_rationale.privacy: Same fixed public stable slots, 2 M_v C sensitivity, exact discrete Gaussian, full T composition, per-node epsilon/delta; no noise reduction for lower dimension.
preregistration_rationale.controls: All new matched positive-head public_init and clipped zero-noise Non-Private T=100; both uniform participation profiles retained. Original full Non-Private T=500 only a historical upper reference.
preregistration_rationale.parameter_rule: One public configuration for all datasets and model seeds; no preview of new real-benchmark rankings or Coverage before registration.
preregistration_rationale.revision_limit: Second and final development mechanism revision; no further architecture, hyperparameter or noise-luck search after this round.

confirmation_gate.meaning: Predeclared engineering gate, not a statistical significance or noninferiority test.
confirmation_gate.if_pass: Freeze a separate four-dataset confirmation protocol before reading those Coverage results.
confirmation_gate.if_fail: Stop further development search and report full evidence.
confirmation_gate.personalization_advantage: Report comparisons with both uniform controls and public initialization even if no advantage; no superiority claim from the gate alone.

confirmation_plan.configuration_rule: Same positive encoder, constrained readout, C/B/T, learning rate, privacy targets and slot routing as v3; publicly fixed n=40 on all four confirmation datasets.
confirmation_plan.additional_control: slots_zero_noise uses full participation 4/4/4 and no noise; non_private remains the matched 1/2/4 zero-noise control. Both reported.
confirmation_plan.source_delta_after_development: Only explicit public sampling-accounting metadata and trusted per-slot q metadata added; no gradient, sampling, update or noise behavior changed.
confirmation_plan.report: Every dataset, method and model seed retained; no post-confirmation method or seed selection; no superiority claim if public initialization or uniform controls match PDP.
confirmation_plan.after_confirmation: No further development mechanism or hyperparameter search.
